articles.summary: Employees across Alaska and Hawaiian came together to help transport the remains of an unidentified World War II airman for possible identification, bringing one family closer to answers after generations of waiting. That same commitment to service continues year-round through Honor Flights, the Fallen Soldier Program and initiatives that help military talent build careers in aviation.
articles.title: From Honor Flights to fallen heroes: How Alaska and Hawaiian honor those who have served
